Calcium supplementation was ef- fective in relieving the luteal phase symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (p.2099) in 1 study.1 A review of this and other studies suggested that calcium supplementation at a dose of 1.2 to 1.6 g daily should be considered in patients with premenstrual syn- drome.2 1.
